## Plot colors
```{r colors and order, include=FALSE}
treat.colors <- c("control"  = "darkseagreen" , "chicken"= "royalblue1", "cow" = "red3","pellet"= "darkorchid1","compost"="chocolate4")
treat.colors1 <- c("control_amf"  = "darkseagreen" , "chicken"= "royalblue1", "cow" = "red3","pellet"= "darkorchid1","compost"="chocolate4")
time.colors <- c("#BFD3E6", "#9ECAE1", "#6BAED6", "#4292C6", "#2171B5", "#08519C")


treat.order  <- c("control",  "chicken", "cow","compost", "pellet")
treat.order1  <- c("control_amf",  "chicken", "cow","compost", "pellet")
treat.labels <- c("Control",  "Chicken\nmanure", "Cow\nmanure","Compost", "Pelletised\ncompost")

treat.colors_ok <- c("Control"  = "darkseagreen" , "Chicken\nmanure"= "royalblue1", "Cow\nmanure" = "red3","Pelletised\ncompost"= "darkorchid1","Compost"="chocolate4")
```

## Load data

```{r}
zotu97 <- import_qiime("../01_Raw_data/p1031_run231023_ITS_ccs_ZOTU_c97_Count_Sintax.txt")

metadata <- read.csv("../01_Raw_data/metadata_2025.csv" ) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var= "sample_name")
metadata$treat.pot <- paste(metadata$treatment, metadata$rep, sep= "_")

zotu97 <- merge_phyloseq(zotu97, sample_data(metadata))



##modifiyin the table to change rowxcol
otu_mat <- otu_table(`zotu97`)
if (taxa_are_rows(`zotu97`)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)          
}
otu_mat <- as.matrix(otu_mat)
min_reads <- 3       
min_samples <- 3     
prevalence <- colSums(otu_mat >= min_reads)
keep_otus <- prevalence >= min_samples

otu_filt <- otu_mat[, keep_otus, drop = FALSE]
cat("ZOTUs kept:", ncol(otu_filt), "out of", ncol(otu_mat), "\n")


zotu_filt <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(otu_filt, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  sample_data(sample_data(zotu97)),      
  tax_table(tax_table(zotu97)[keep_otus, ])
)
zotu_filt
```

## TSS transformation

```{r}
zotu_tss_pct <- transform_sample_counts(
  zotu_filt,
  function(x) x / sum(x) * 100
)
```

## Filamentous fungi

```{r fungi}
cfu_fungi<-readxl::read_excel("../01_Raw_data/cfu_fungi.xlsx")
phy_phylum <- tax_glom(zotu_tss_pct, taxrank = "Phylum")

fungi_phy <- subset_taxa(
  phy_phylum,
 Phylum %in% c("Ascomycota"))

fungi_df <- psmelt(fungi_phy) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, sample_ID, Abundance) %>%
  rename(RA_fungi = Abundance)
fungi_df <- as.data.frame(fungi_df)
rownames(fungi_df)

fungi_df <- psmelt(fungi_phy) %>%
  group_by(Sample, sample_ID) %>%
  summarise(RA_fungi = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

cfu_fungi_join <- cfu_fungi %>%
  left_join(fungi_df, by = "sample_ID")
#CORRELATIONS
cfu_fungi_join <- cfu_fungi_join %>%
  mutate(
    log10_fungi_cfu = log10(fungi_cfu_g_soil), 
    RA_fungi_t=log10(RA_fungi + 1)
  )
cfu_fungi_join$sqrt_cfu <- sqrt(cfu_fungi_join$fungi_cfu_g_soil)
shapiro.test(cfu_fungi_join$sqrt_cfu)
shapiro.test(cfu_fungi_join$log10_fungi_cfu)
shapiro.test(cfu_fungi_join$RA_fungi)


spearman_fungi <- cor.test(
  cfu_fungi_join$log10_fungi_cfu,
  cfu_fungi_join$RA_fungi,
  method = "spearman"
)
spearman_fungi

#lm_fungi <- lm(RA_fungi_t ~ log10_fungi_cfu, data = cfu_fungi_join)
#summary(lm_fungi)


label_text_fungi <- sprintf(
  "Spearman ρ = %.2f | p = %.3g",
  spearman_fungi$estimate,
  spearman_fungi$p.value
)
label_text_fungi

##graff
fungi_plot <- ggplot(cfu_fungi_join,
                              aes(x = log10_fungi_cfu, y = RA_fungi)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = treatment), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = treat.colors1,
    breaks = treat.order,
    labels = treat.labels,
    name   = "Treatment"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[10]~"CFU g"^{-1}~"soil (cultivable filamentous fungi)"),
    y = "Relative abundance (%) of putative \ncultivable filamentous fungi (Ascomycota)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  annotate("text",
           x = Inf, y = Inf,
           hjust = 1.2, vjust = 1.3,
           label = label_text_fungi,
           size = 4)

fungi_plot


ggsave(fungi_plot, file= "../04_Figures/Figure_4B_Fungi.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(fungi_plot, file = '../03_Analysis_files/Figure_4B_Fungi.rds')
```

## Trichoderma

```{r trichoderma ra}
tax_dada2 <- readRDS("../01_Raw_data/dada2_trial/taxonomy_ITS_dada2.RDa")
zotu97 <- import_qiime("../01_Raw_data/p1031_run231023_ITS_ccs_ZOTU_c97_Count_Sintax.txt")


zotu97 <- merge_phyloseq(zotu97, sample_data(metadata))
# OTUs que están en ambos objetos
otus_common <- intersect(taxa_names(zotu97), rownames(tax_dada2))

length(otus_common)  
# Crear matriz taxonómica ordenada según los taxa de zotu97
tax_mat <- as.matrix(tax_dada2[ taxa_names(zotu97), , drop = FALSE ])

# Asignar la tax_table de DADA2 al phyloseq
tax_table(zotu97) <- tax_table(tax_mat)
zotu97dada <- merge_phyloseq(zotu97, sample_data(metadata))


otu_mat_dada <- otu_table(`zotu97dada`)

if (taxa_are_rows(`zotu97dada`)) {
  otu_mat_dada <- t(otu_mat_dada)          
}
otu_mat_dada <- as.matrix(otu_mat_dada)
min_reads <- 3       # abundancia mínima
min_samples <- 3     # número mínimo de muestras
prevalence <- colSums(otu_mat_dada >= min_reads)
keep_otus <- prevalence >= min_samples

otu_filt_dada <- otu_mat_dada[, keep_otus, drop = FALSE]
cat("ZOTUs ketp:", ncol(otu_filt_dada), "of", ncol(otu_mat_dada), "\n")
##tranformation tss

physeq_total_tss <- transform_sample_counts(zotu97dada, function(x) x / sum(x))

tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_total_tss))
unique(tax_df$Genus)

hypocreales_df <- tax_df %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Family == "f__Hypocreaceae")

otus_trichoderma <- setdiff(
  rownames(hypocreales_df),
  c("ZOTU2169", "ZOTU1901", "ZOTU1027")
)

otus_trichoderma
length(otus_trichoderma)
physeq_trichoderma <- prune_taxa(otus_trichoderma, physeq_total_tss)
physeq_trichoderma



trichoderma_melt <- psmelt(physeq_trichoderma) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = treat.order,
      labels = treat.labels
    )
  )

melt_rel <- psmelt(physeq_trichoderma)
trichoderma_relativa_total <- melt_rel %>%
  filter(OTU %in% otus_trichoderma)

trichoderma_sum <- trichoderma_relativa_total %>%
  group_by(Sample, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    trichoderma_percent = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
trichoderma_sum <- trichoderma_sum %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = treat.order))


trichoderma_RA <- ggplot(trichoderma_sum,
                         aes(x = treatment, y = trichoderma_percent)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = treatment),
    alpha = 0.35,
    width = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = treatment),
    width  = 0.15,
    size   = 2.2,
    alpha  = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = treat.colors, breaks = treat.order, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = treat.colors,
    breaks = treat.order,
    labels = treat.labels)+
  labs(
  x = "Treatment",
  y = expression(italic("Trichoderma")~" relative abundance (%)")
)+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(treat.labels, treat.order)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

trichoderma_RA
ggsave(trichoderma_RA, file= "../04_Figures/Supplementary_FigureS8C_Trichoderma_RA.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(trichoderma_RA, file = '../03_Analysis_files/Supplementary_plot/Supplementary_FigureS8C_Trichoderma_RA.rds')


```

## Correlation

```{r}
cfu_trichoderma<-readxl::read_excel("../01_Raw_data/cfu_trichoderma.xlsx")

physeq_trichoderma
trichoderma_relativa_total

trichoderma_relativa_total2 <- trichoderma_relativa_total %>%
  dplyr::select(-treatment, -time)

cfu_trichoderma_join <- cfu_trichoderma %>%
  left_join(trichoderma_relativa_total2, by = "sample_ID")
#CORRELATIONS
cfu_trichoderma_join <- cfu_trichoderma_join%>%
  mutate(
    log10_tricho = log10(cfu_g+1), 
    RA_tricho_t=log10(Abundance + 2)
  )
shapiro.test(cfu_trichoderma_join$log10_tricho)
shapiro.test(cfu_trichoderma_join$RA_tricho_t)

tricho_corre<-cor.test(
  cfu_trichoderma_join$log10_tricho,
  cfu_trichoderma_join$RA_tricho_t,
  method = "spearman"
)
tricho_corre



label_text_tricho <- sprintf(
  "Spearman ρ = %.3f | p = %.4f",
  tricho_corre$estimate,
  tricho_corre$p.value
)
label_text_tricho
##graff
trichoderma_plot <- ggplot(cfu_trichoderma_join,
                     aes(x = log10_tricho, y = Abundance)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = treatment), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = treat.colors1,
    breaks = treat.order1,
    labels = treat.labels,
    name   = "Treatment"
  ) +
 labs(
  x = expression(log[10]~"CFU g"^{-1}~"soil ("*italic("Trichoderma")*")"),
  y = expression("Relative abundance (%) of "*italic("Trichoderma"))
)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  annotate("text",
           x = Inf, y = Inf,
           hjust = 1.2, vjust = 1.3,
           label = label_text_tricho,
           size = 4)
 
  
trichoderma_plot
ggsave(trichoderma_plot, file= "../04_Figures/Supplementary_FigureS8B_Trichoderma_CFU.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(trichoderma_plot, file = '../03_Analysis_files/Supplementary_plot/Supplementary_FigureS8B_Trichoderma_CFU.rds')


```
